rule_sources.allowed_occupations: Farmers - individual/joint borrowers who are owner cultivators; tenant farmers, oral lessees & share croppers; Self Help Groups (SHGs) or Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) of farmers.

unmodelled_conditions: Eligible as an individual/joint borrower who is an owner cultivator, a tenant farmer, oral lessee or share cropper, or as a member of an SHG or Joint Liability Group of farmers.
